chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Washa, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the chief of the sauces (cooked food) in the world and the Hereafter, so he (peace be upon him) said: The meat.
Have you not heard the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And the flesh of fowl such as they would be desiring'.

key_terms.سَيِّدُ الْآدَامِ: Chief or master of the sauces/cooked foods

ai.seo_question: What is the chief of sauces in Paradise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Abdullah ibn Sinan asks Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the 'chief of sauces' (sayyid al-adham) in this world and the Hereafter, to which the Imam replies that it is 'meat' (al-lahm). He supports this by citing the Quranic verse from Surah al-Dhariyat (51:22) mentioning 'the flesh of fowl' as a delicacy desired by the people of Paradise, highlighting the high status of meat as a primary enhancer of food in Shia culinary and spiritual tradition.
